decision.observation: The farmer is just south of the mailbox at 6:50 p.m., with shrubs blocking the direct eastern route and a clear dirt path farther north.
decision.hypothesis: Moving north onto the mailbox-level path will clear the shrubs and allow uninterrupted travel east toward the farm exit.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. From the farm, use the clear path beside the mailbox, go east through the bus stop into Pelican Town, then turn south rather than continuing to the eastern riverbank. Passing out costs money.
